rubric.item: SPEC-13 correctness (locked-test edits limited to Q-5 dropdown count/selection lines)
SPEC-14 correctness (gates: lint, typecheck, tests, coverage pass)

findings.issue: TimerWindow / useWorkerTimers / restorePausedTimers / axeWithPausedClock are a byte-identical copy of the helper already in e2e/review.spec.ts, e2e/next-hand.spec.ts, e2e/table-display.spec.ts and e2e/action-bar.spec.ts. This is now the 5th copy.
findings.evidence: grep -rln 'function useWorkerTimers' e2e -> 5 files; diff of the review.spec.ts and players-choice.spec.ts blocks is empty.
findings.fix: Not in this story: the other four files are outside the spec's file list. Create a follow-up task to move axeWithPausedClock into e2e/support/axe.ts (or paused-clock.ts) and import it in all five specs. That needs unlock approval for any locked spec among them.

findings.issue: REFERENCE_SIZE_TABLE maps a reference size to its exact player count, but the name reads like a table of reference sizes.
The hard-coded [2, 6, 9, 10] list does not say why 9 gets no note even though referenceSizeOf(9) is full-ring like 8. A reader may think 9 is a bug.
findings.fix: Name the requirement in the doc comment, e.g. 'REQ-005.4: 9 is treated as full ring with no note'.

summary: All of SPEC-01..14 are implemented as specified. configForPlayers follows D-4 at every size, and n=6 deep-equals the defaults. The note shows only at 3/4/5/7 (6-max) and 8 (full ring), with aria-describedby only while it shows. Heads-up positionName is button=Small blind, other seat=Big blind, which matches the engine blinds and is pinned across a button move. Position lists for 2..10 match TASK-3.3 A-2. Review grading is covered at 2 and 10 players. All three TABLE_SIZE_NAMES are used, through option labels and the note. The 5 locked-test edits are confined to select/combobox counts and picking the stake select by id. The e2e waits only through runUntilMyTurn under a paused clock. The tests would catch broken behaviour: no note at 9, aria-describedby always on, wrong heads-up labels, Start game ignoring the chosen size. Timing: the 7 related vitest files take about 0.3 s (review test 132 ms), and the 3 related Playwright specs in Chromium and WebKit take 5.6 s (players-choice about 2.5 s per browser). The only notable item is the 5th copy of the axe paused-clock helper (MINOR, follow-up task). No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
